parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: MemberAccountId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the managed member.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request. The system automatically obtains the value of this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi delete-member-account --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id waf_esasdf30000 --source-ip 0.0.XX.XX --member-account-id 1310000000000039 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
